fill.summaryAnswer:
— We came back from grandma's with three buckets of tomatoes and ate half of them in the garden.
— Dad over-salted the first jar of cucumbers; the second was good enough that people asked for the recipe.
— Mark made the jam himself and let nobody stir it: plum, a little bitter, but his own.
— Nine of us sat down at the table, and the guests took jars home.
fill.nextIdeas:
— Month of our own neighbourhood: walk every street and draw our own map.
— Bake bread on our own starter and take it to grandma.
— Sort out the cellar and label everything that has stood there since last year.
— A week of cooking only from what we put up ourselves.
